item.title: Palantir Could Be the Most Overvalued Company That Ever Existed
item.description:
📝 At this current share price level, PLTR stock is now trading at 360-times trailing earnings and 153-times forward earnings. But ultimately, it’s my view that financial markets will eventually catch on to Palantir’s outlandish valuation and this is a stock that will come back down to earth. I can’t disagree with that view right now.
🔗 Read more: https://247wallst.com/investing/2025/11/25/palantir-could-be-the-most-overvalued-company-that-ever-existed/
